) on Monday said it has signed an agreement to acquire a majority interest in Fox Soccer Academy, an international youth soccer organization co-founded by former Premier League champion Christian Fuchs and sports executive Raluca Gold-Fuchs.
Fox Soccer Academy operates across key markets in the United States, including New York and North Carolina, as well as in the United Kingdom and Austria.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in the coming weeks, Nomader said.

Following completion of the transaction, Christian Fuchs and Raluca Gold-Fuchs will remain as partners in Fox Soccer Academy and will continue to play an active role in the development, expansion, and long-term strategy of the academy alongside Nomadar, the company added.

"The acquisition expands Nomadar's presence in the United States, where the Company has been working for the past two years with North American players through international development initiatives connecting the U.S. market with Spain and Cádiz Club de Fútbol, a professional football club within the LaLiga ecosystem," the company said.

title: Nomadar to acquire majority interest in Fox Soccer Academy
